---
title: "update-quarto-extensions.yml"
---

Update vendored Quarto extensions in-place to upstream semver tags and open
or refresh an automation pull request when newer versions are available.

Preserves the repository's existing directory layout (flat
`_extensions/<name>/` vs nested `_extensions/<owner>/<name>/`), fails loudly
if a vendored copy was modified locally without matching any published upstream
release tag, and never modifies `_quarto.yml`.

## Inputs

| Input               | Type    | Default                              | Description                                                                                                   |
| ------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `extension-repos`   | string  | `''`                                 | Mapping of extension names to upstream GitHub repositories (`owner/repo`). Built-in defaults cover common d-morrison extensions. |
| `extensions-dir`    | string  | `_extensions`                        | Directory holding vendored Quarto extensions.                                                                 |
| `base-branch`       | string  | `main`                               | Base branch to open the PR against.                                                                           |
| `pr-branch`         | string  | `automated/update-quarto-extensions` | Head branch for the automation PR.                                                                            |
| `labels`            | string  | `dependencies, quarto`               | Comma-separated labels to apply to the automation PR.                                                         |
| `dry-run`           | boolean | `false`                              | When true, detect and log updates without modifying files or opening a PR.                                    |
| `allow-local-edits` | boolean | `false`                              | When true, overwrite vendored copies even if they differ from all published upstream tags.                   |

## Secrets

| Secret           | Required | Description                                                         |
| ---------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `WORKFLOW_TOKEN` | no       | PAT or App token; needed to push to a protected branch or run checks.|

## Permissions

Grant `contents: write` and `pull-requests: write`, and enable Settings ->
Actions -> General -> "Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests".

## Example

```yaml
# Copy to .github/workflows/update-quarto-extensions.yml in your repo.
# Periodically update vendored Quarto extensions in-place to upstream semver tags.
# Requires Settings -> Actions -> General -> "Allow GitHub Actions to create and
# approve pull requests" (the integrated GITHUB_TOKEN opens the PR).
name: Update Quarto extensions

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 6 * * 1' # Weekly on Monday at 06:00 UTC

jobs:
  update:
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/update-quarto-extensions.yml@v3
    with:
      # Optional: custom extension repository mapping (owner/repo). Built-in
      # defaults already cover common d-morrison extensions (code-language-labels,
      # div-anchors, equation-anchors, slidebreak, revealjs-html-links,
      # callouty-theorem).
      # extension-repos: |
      #   my-extension: my-org/my-extension
      # extensions-dir: _extensions
      # dry-run: false
    secrets:
      # Optional: set only if the bot must push to a protected branch or
      # trigger subsequent pull_request checks; otherwise omit and falls back to
      # GITHUB_TOKEN.
      WORKFLOW_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.WORKFLOW_TOKEN }}
```

See
[`examples/update-quarto-extensions.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/update-quarto-extensions.yml)
for the full caller stub.
